howWeHelp.title: How We Help
howWeHelp.description: Everything you need to engage families, support residents and streamline service delivery — in one place:

keep-families-connected.title: Keep Families Connected, Reassured and Informed – Every Day
keep-families-connected.description: Give families what they want most: meaningful connection, proactive updates and peace of mind. Whether near or far, families stay closely connected to the day-to-day lives of their loved ones through real-time updates, media-rich moments and smart notification

make-every-day-count.title: Make Every Day Count with Smarter Life Enrichment Planning
make-every-day-count.description: Run engaging, person-centred life enrichment programming with far less admin. From planning to participation tracking, everything is built for speed, clarity and impact – helping your team focus more on what matters most: the people you support.

empower-every-individual.title: Empower Every Individual with Personalised Content and Routines
empower-every-individual.description: Bring learning, leisure and independence into the hands of those you support. From tailored content to structured routines, everything is designed to engage, empower and enrich daily living experiences.

unite-and-simplify.title: Unite and Simplify Team Communication and Tasks
unite-and-simplify.description: Cut through the noise with a single hub for communication, workflows and task management. Your team stays aligned, informed and focused – with less admin and more time for meaningful care.

turn-everyday-data.title: Turn Everyday Data into Actionable Insights
turn-everyday-data.description: Capture participation, feedback and outcomes in real time. With clear dashboards, instant reports and built-in surveys, you get the clarity you need to measure impact and make better decisions, faster.

seemlessly-connect.title: Seamlessly Connect with Your Care Management Systems
seemlessly-connect.description: No duplicate work, no silos. Altra integrates directly with your care management software, so data flows where it should – saving time, improving accuracy and giving your team a single source of truth.

hero.subtitle: Elderly Care
hero.title: Enhance Quality of Life. Strengthen Family Connection. Streamline Care.
hero.description: Altra supports elderly care services in delivering high-quality, person-centred care while reducing administrative load. Whether you're running a single home or managing a larger group, our platform helps you engage families, empower staff, and improve outcomes for your residents — every day.

aboutGrid.title: What Altra Helps You Achieve in Elderly Care

items.title: Support Resident Wellbeing
items.description: Keep minds active and spirits high with our Wellbeing Library, a hub of expert-led content including seated fitness, music, mindfulness and more — designed specifically for older adults in care.

items.title: Improve Communication with Families
items.description: Share regular updates, photos, and videos using our Family Engagement module. Families stay connected and reassured, which improves satisfaction and reduces complaints.

items.title: Keep Everyone Informed
items.description: Use Digital Displays to show menus, activities and announcements in common areas, and automatically update these from a central dashboard — no USB sticks or slideshows needed.

items.title: Streamline New Resident Onboarding
items.description: Ensure consistency and save time with our Workflow engine. From room prep to 7-day reviews, every task is tracked and nothing falls through the cracks.

items.title: Communicate Seamlessly with Staff
items.description: Use Staff Communication module to keep caregivers updated on schedule changes, new appointments or urgent messages — all within the Altra app, with no need for separate messaging platforms.

items.title: Get the Insights You Need
items.description: With Reporting, track activity attendance, engagement trends and satisfaction scores. Identify what's working and where to improve — all in one place.

checklist.title: Why Elderly Care Providers Choose Altra

items.title: Better Family Satisfaction
items.description: By keeping families connected and informed, homes reduce complaints and increase peace of mind.

items.title: Happier, More Engaged Residents
items.description: Structured activity tools and wellbeing content support both physical and mental health.

items.title: Less Time on Admin
items.description: From digital menus to task automation, Altra cuts back paperwork so your team can focus on care.

items.title: Inspection-Ready
items.description: Evidence resident engagement, communication and compliance with easy-to-access logs and dashboards.

cta.text: See how Altra supports person-centred care in elderly services.

hero.subtitle: LD & Supported Living
hero.title: Support Greater Independence, Communication and Inclusion.
hero.description: Altra helps supported living and learning disability services provide person-led care through better communication, engaging content, and tools that promote independence. With a focus on outcomes for People Supported, our platform empowers care teams to deliver consistent support while giving individuals more control, visibility and connection.

aboutGrid.title: How Altra Supports Better Outcomes for People Supported

items.title: Promote Daily Structure and Independence
items.description: Use the Resident Content Library to deliver personalised guides that help people start their day, navigate routines, or feel more confident going out in the community — tailored to their needs and abilities.

items.title: Empower with Voice Assistants
items.description: With Voice Assistants, individuals can access their daily schedule, request support, or check what's happening in the home using simple, natural commands. It builds confidence and reduces reliance on staff for routine questions.

items.title: Support Routine Through Visual Planning
items.description: The Activities Calendar provides visibility into what's happening each day, supports planning around routines, and helps people supported build confidence in joining in. Participation can be logged and shared easily.

items.title: Keep Families Informed and Involved
items.description: Our Family Engagement module allow services to proactively share updates, moments and communication with loved ones. This reduces anxiety and helps build a shared support network around the individual.

items.title: Track What Matters
items.description: With Reporting, services can measure activity participation, engagement, and preferences — helping teams personalise support and evidence meaningful outcomes for each person.

checklist.title: Why Supported Living Providers Choose Altra

items.title: Supports Individual Goals
items.description: Content and tools can be tailored to encourage skill-building and greater autonomy.

items.title: Clear Communication
items.description: Everyone — including families — stays in the loop, improving trust and reducing confusion or duplication.

items.title: Consistency Across Teams
items.description: No matter who's on shift, teams follow the same processes and have access to the same information.

items.title: Visual and Accessible
items.description: Tools are designed to support varying abilities — with image-based content, voice control and simplified interfaces.

cta.text: See how Altra helps supported living services empower every person supported.

hero.subtitle: Independent Living
hero.title: A Modern Experience for Active, Independent Older Adults
hero.description: Altra helps independent living communities deliver a more connected, informed and resident-led experience. From digital signage to personalised resident apps, Altra enhances everyday life for active older adults — while giving teams the tools to manage communication, services and scheduling with ease.

aboutGrid.title: How Altra Supports Independent Living Communities

items.title: Keep Residents Informed in Real Time
items.description: Use Digital Displays to show daily menus, activity calendars, event highlights and community updates in shared spaces — no paper, no PowerPoint, just real-time info where residents need it most.

items.title: Empower with the Resident App
items.description: Give residents direct access to their Activities Calendar, menus, notices, and important updates through the Altra app. It supports greater autonomy while reducing demand on front desk teams.

items.title: Book Services with Ease
items.description: With Concierge, residents can request services, report maintenance needs or book extras (like guest meals or wellbeing treatments) directly from their app — all tracked and managed by your team in one dashboard.

items.title: Build an Active, Engaging Schedule
items.description: From fitness classes to movie nights and community outings, Altra's Activities Calendar makes it easy to plan, share and adapt events for a vibrant lifestyle — with participation logging and resident preferences built in.

items.title: Launch Your Own Branded App
items.description: For groups and premium providers, Altra offers a Fully Branded App — your own branded app in the App Store. Give residents and families a modern, fully branded digital experience while reinforcing your brand identity.

checklist.title: Why Independent Living Communities Choose Altra

items.title: Enhances Lifestyle
items.description: Residents enjoy clear communication, easy service access and a stronger sense of connection with their community.

items.title: Reduces Admin for Teams
items.description: Digital tools reduce repetitive tasks and allow teams to focus on service, not logistics.

items.title: Promotes Autonomy
items.description: Residents can view, choose and act independently across events, requests and updates.

items.title: Professional, Branded Experience
items.description: From the app to signage, everything reflects your brand and values.

cta.text: See how Altra helps you deliver a modern experience for independent older adults.
